# Tyler Xiao

> Personal portfolio for Tyler Xiao, a software engineer and UCLA computer science student building AI systems, backend infrastructure, and independent software products.

This is an interactive portfolio. Use the resume and experience page for text-first details, and use linked repositories or live products for implementation evidence. Role dates and availability are time-sensitive.

## Portfolio

- [Studio Bench](https://tylerx.dev/): Primary portfolio with profile, work, experiments, and project history.
- [Experience](https://tylerx.dev/past-experience): Work timeline, focus areas, projects, and supporting links.
- [Blog](https://tylerx.dev/blog): Technical notes on AI agents, backend systems, and product engineering.
- [Resume](https://tylerx.dev/resume/resume.pdf): Current resume in PDF format.

## Alternate interfaces

- [Orbital view](https://tylerx.dev/orbital): Spatial view of the same portfolio material.
- [Terminal view](https://tylerx.dev/terminal): Command-line interface for exploring the site.

## Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/lordboba): Public source repositories and contribution history.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tyler-xiao): Professional profile.
